hints.title: How to read the distance
hints.content: Use `double distance = rangeSensor.getDistance(DistanceUnit.CM);` to get the distance in centimeters.

hints.title: Setting up the if/else chain
hints.content: Check the smallest threshold first: `if (distance < 10)` then `else if (distance < 30)` then `else`. This ensures each range is handled correctly.

hints.title: What power should the motor be?
hints.content: The sensor reads 15.0 cm. Since 15 is not less than 10, but it is less than 30, the motor should be set to 0.5.
